page_evidence.observation: The cover exposes school, team number, and member names.
The abstract reports Mann-Kendall, wavelets, spatial interpolation, PCA, random forest, ARIMA, Prophet, and quantitative fit metrics by task.
A correlation heatmap and scree plot justify reducing climate factors.
Observed sea temperature is compared with global temperature before forecasting.
Historical and Prophet forecast segments are visually separated and a year-value table is supplied.
Random-forest importance is paired with normality tests and correlation-method choices.
Code excerpts contain absolute local paths and a network download call.

abstract_structure.observation: For each climate task, name the data scope, method, dominant result, and validation metric where available.

model_chain.observation: Use climate slope, Mann-Kendall change detection, and wavelet periodicity analysis.
Use correlation analysis and PCA to reduce climate drivers.
Fit ARIMA and Prophet models to temperature series.
Use random forest to rank and classify important climate drivers.

validation_chain.observation: Inspect the correlation matrix and cumulative variance before choosing components.
Report a high fit score for the selected forecasting model.
Provide explicit annual forecasts beside the plotted series.
Choose Pearson or Spearman after normality tests.

figures.lesson: Place correlation and retained-dimension evidence on one page.
Compare related temperatures over the same years before causal discussion.
Separate observed and forecast segments and provide exact tabular values.
Combine model importance with tests that justify the correlation analysis.

code_links.note: No independently packaged source tree was paired with this exact PDF; embedded appendix fragments are not treated as reproducible code.

transferable_rules.rule: Pair a correlation heatmap with a scree or cumulative-variance plot before PCA-based modeling.
Put exact forecast values beside the visual forecast when decisions depend on them.
Let distribution checks determine the reported correlation statistic.

risks.risk: Embedded code contains absolute local paths and a network call, so it is neither portable nor safe to batch-run.
Many algorithms are stacked across subproblems; model-selection logic is not always equally deep.
The award status has no independent official evidence.

provenance.review_method: full-page render overview plus 4-7 high-resolution evidence-page visual checks and extracted-text review
